facts.fact: UCSAF paid TZS 71bn of the TZS 126bn cost of the 758-tower rural connectivity project (the World Bank paid TZS 55bn), per the minister's report to the Parliamentary Infrastructure Committee.

systems.country_label: Universal Communications Service Access Fund (Mfuko wa Mawasiliano kwa Wote)
systems.owner: Ministry of Information and Communication Technology

note: World Bank share (TZS 55bn) is a lender grant or loan and gives no fact; the document names no UCSAF law or budget year.
